name: Puducherry
summary: Comprises 4 non-contiguous geographical enclaves: Puducherry & Karaikal (in Tamil Nadu), Yanam (in Andhra Pradesh), and Mahe (in Kerala). Former French colonial capital; home to Sri Aurobindo Ashram and experimental global township Auroville.
festivals: Bastille Day (14 July), Fete de Puducherry, French Food Festival
rivers: Gingee (Sankaraparani), Mahe River, Coringa (Godavari distributary in Yanam)
monuments: Auroville (Matrimandir - 'Temple of the Mother'), Sri Aurobindo Ashram, Promenade Beach, French Quarter (White Town)
schemes: Free Rice Scheme, Laptop distribution for higher education

subtopics.name: Geography
subtopics.summary: Location, borders, physical terrain, and major river systems of Puducherry.

facts.title: Capital & Geographic Scope
facts.content: The capital is Puducherry. Puducherry covers a geographic area of 492 sq km across 4 administrative districts.

facts.title: Major Rivers & Drainage Systems
facts.content: Key river systems flowing through the region include: Gingee (Sankaraparani), Mahe River, Coringa (Godavari distributary in Yanam).

facts.title: Geographical Landscape & Highlights
facts.content: Comprises 4 non-contiguous geographical enclaves: Puducherry & Karaikal (in Tamil Nadu), Yanam (in Andhra Pradesh), and Mahe (in Kerala). Former French colonial capital; home to Sri Aurobindo Ashram and experimental global township Auroville.

subtopics.name: History & Culture
subtopics.summary: Historical formation, classical/folk dances, and vibrant festivals of Puducherry.

facts.title: State Formation & Language
facts.content: Puducherry was formally instituted on 16 August 1962 (De Jure transfer from France). Official language(s): Tamil, French, Telugu, Malayalam, English.

facts.title: Dance Forms & Traditional Arts
facts.content: Celebrated traditional and folk dance forms: Garadi (celebrating Rama's victory over Ravana).

facts.title: Major Festivals & Celebrations
facts.content: Prominent cultural festivals: Bastille Day (14 July), Fete de Puducherry, French Food Festival.

subtopics.name: Government & Polity
subtopics.summary: Constitutional leadership, administrative structure, and state symbols of Puducherry.

facts.title: Lieutenant Governor & Constitutional Head
facts.content: The current Lieutenant Governor is K. Kailashnathan.

facts.title: Chief Minister & Administration
facts.content: The Chief Minister of Puducherry is N. Rangasamy.

facts.title: High Court Jurisdiction
facts.content: Judicial jurisdiction falls under Madras High Court (Chennai).

facts.title: Official State Symbols
facts.content: State Animal: Indian palm squirrel | State Bird: Asian koel | State Flower: Cannonball flower (Nagalingam) | State Tree: Bael fruit tree.

subtopics.name: Economy & Agriculture
subtopics.summary: Natural resources, minerals, industrial clusters, and agriculture in Puducherry.

facts.title: Mineral Wealth & Natural Resources
facts.content: Principal minerals and resources: Lignite, Limestone.

facts.title: Economic Profile & Industries
facts.content: Puducherry plays a vital role in India's economy through key agricultural production, manufacturing corridors, and services.

subtopics.name: Places, Monuments & Tourism
subtopics.summary: Heritage landmarks, national parks, and tourism attractions in Puducherry.

facts.title: Historic Monuments & Cultural Sites
facts.content: Prominent monuments and heritage landmarks: Auroville (Matrimandir - 'Temple of the Mother'), Sri Aurobindo Ashram, Promenade Beach, French Quarter (White Town).

facts.title: National Parks & Protected Areas
facts.content: Key protected conservation areas: Ousteri Lake (Ramsar Conservation Site).

subtopics.name: State Schemes & Awards
subtopics.summary: Prominent welfare schemes, civic initiatives, and state honors of Puducherry.

facts.title: Key State Welfare Schemes
facts.content: Notable welfare initiatives and government programs: Free Rice Scheme, Laptop distribution for higher education.
